about.text: A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to provide for examination and disclosure with respect to Presidential income tax returns, to amend chapter 131 of title 5, United States Code, to require the disclosure of certain tax returns by Presidents and certain candidates for the office of the President, and for other purposes.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

effective.note: Not enacted as of the date of the data (stage reached: Introduced). A bill becomes law only when both chambers pass the same text and the President signs it, lets it become law without a signature, or is overridden. It has no effective date.
